source: Dell Latitude 3470 Owner's Manual (port list, 342 × 243.3 × 23.15 mm, display active area 309.4 × 173.95 mm, optional fingerprint reader) and Notebookcheck/Laptop Mag reviews for which side each port is on. Positions along each side are estimates in the published order. The status lights aren't included because no source states where they are; add them once checked on the laptop.

ports.label: Power connector
ports.info: Round barrel connector for the Dell AC adapter.
specs: 65 W or 90 W Dell adapter, 19.5 V

ports.label: HDMI
ports.info: Connect an external monitor, TV or projector.
tips: Press Win + P to choose Duplicate or Extend.

ports.label: USB 3.0 (PowerShare)
ports.info: Powered USB 3.0 port. It can also be used for Windows kernel debugging.

ports.label: USB 3.0
ports.info: USB 3.0 port for drives and accessories.

ports.label: Security lock slot
ports.info: Attach a cable lock to secure the laptop to a desk.

ports.label: VGA
ports.info: 15-pin VGA for older monitors and projectors.
tips: Press Win + P to choose Duplicate or Extend.

ports.label: USB 2.0
ports.info: USB 2.0 port, fine for a mouse or keyboard.

ports.label: SD card reader
ports.info: Full-size SD card reader. The card sticks out slightly when inserted.

ports.label: Power button
ports.info: Press to turn on or sleep. Hold about 6 seconds to force a shutdown.
tips: Position is an estimate (top-right above the keyboard); check against your laptop.

ports.label: Fingerprint reader
ports.info: Optional fingerprint reader for Windows Hello sign-in. Separate from the power button.
